subject: Onramp: Renewal & capacity planning + QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@coremed.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onramp: Renewal & capacity planning + QBR scheduling

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the productive conversation last week. As we discussed, CoreMed's current agreement (expiring 2029-01-31) is a great candidate for a straightforward renewal with a modest capacity uplift to cover the new triage and billing workloads you ramped in H2. I wanted to kick off the onramp/renewal thread so we have a single place to track timeline, stakeholders, and the QBR cadence.

Quick summary / proposal:
- Term: 12 months with an option to extend to 24 months if procurement requests longer-term pricing.
- Capacity: baseline + 25% burst pool for end-of-month billing windows (we'll surface cost delta).
- Timeline: aim to finalize terms & PO by 2028-12-15 to avoid any service interruptions.
- QBR: propose an initial renewal QBR the week of 2028-11-06 to align stakeholders and confirm metrics.

Action items I have for us:
1) Can you share an updated expected token/throughput profile for Nov–Feb? (attachment: coremed_usage_runbook_2028-10.xlsx)
2) I'll drop a brief term summary and capacity lift options into this thread for procurement to review.
3) Ben will send a 3-slot calendar poll for the QBR.

Attachments in this email: coremed_usage_runbook_2028-10.xlsx (usage export), redwood_renewal_playbook_v2.pdf (playbook that maps our standard run-of-book renewal options).

If you can confirm who should receive the procurement/finance packet (name + email), we'll include them in the next note.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks, Mina — appreciate the clear summary.

Quick answers up front:
- I'll attach a trimmed usage roll-up for Oct; high-level numbers are in the spreadsheet you sent but I'll add expected increases tied to triage automation (we expect ~18% month-over-month growth through January).
- Please include procurement: procurement@coremed.ai and copy in our Head of Finance (Elliot Park, elliot.park@coremed.ai).

A couple of clarifying questions before the QBR:
- Can you outline the cost delta for +25% burst vs. flat baseline (ballpark is fine for the QBR)?
- Are there recommended quantization or caching knobs we'd want to run in prod to avoid a bigger uplift?

Proposed QBR availability: I can do any morning PST slot Tue/Wed/Thu next week. Ben — if you send times, I'll pick.
